name: Inferno Edge
body:
School: transmutation; Level: cleric/oracle 3, druid 3, inquisitor 3, magus 2, ranger 3, sorcerer/wizard 3, summoner 3

CASTING

Components: V, S
Casting: 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range: touch
Targets: weapon touched
Duration: 10 minutes/level
Saving Throw: Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance: yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You wreathe a weapon or natural attack in bright white flames. These flames deal an additional 2d6 fire damage with every attack. The affected weapon sheds light as a torch
